question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).
sql:
WITH pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap, 
           lap - 1 as entry_lap,
           lap as exit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE CAST(lap_type AS VARCHAR) = 'Race' AND lap >= 2
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT rl.race_id, rl.driver_id, rl.lap, rl.prev_position, rl.position,
           CASE WHEN rl.position < rl.prev_position THEN 'overtake'
                WHEN rl.position > rl.prev_position THEN 'overtaken'
                ELSE 'same' END as change_type
    FROM race_laps rl
    WHERE rl.prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_changes AS (
    SELECT pc.*
    FROM position_changes pc
    LEFT JOIN pit_stop_laps ps ON pc.race_id = ps.race_id AND pc.driver_id = ps.driver_id 
        AND (pc.lap = ps.exit_lap OR pc.lap = ps.entry_lap)
    WHERE ps.race_id IS NULL
)
SELECT driver_id, change_type, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM filtered_changes
WHERE driver_id = 28
GROUP BY driver_id, change_type

    FROM lap_positions

           CASE WHEN rl.position < rl.prev_position THEN 'overtake'
                WHEN rl.position > rl.prev_position THEN 'overtaken'
                ELSE 'same' END as change_type
    FROM race_laps rl
    WHERE rl.prev_position IS NOT NULL
